notes: Genelec 8030C official product page: system response 54 Hz–20 kHz (±2 dB); -6 dB cutoffs 47 Hz and 25 kHz; bass amp 50 W + treble amp 50 W Class D (summed to 100 W per the 1031A convention); bass driver diameter 130 mm (=5.12 in, unit conversion only) + 19 mm metal dome; crossover 3000 Hz; reflex enclosure; 5 kg; 285 x 189 x 178 mm. No sensitivity or passive impedance published. The page lists a CLF file (genelec_oy-8030.cf2.zip) whose name does not confirm the 8030C revision (sibling EASE files are labelled 8030a), so NO directivity data has been imported.
